name: Unbound Works — ricostruzione antica
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Wide detailed semi-realistic fantasy novel illustration of the ancient Unbound Works, a functioning independent community after liberation. A stone clean-water channel branches into accessible public cisterns beside an airy brick-and-stone workshop, food storehouses and modest residences. Small adult workers cooperate repairing tools and carrying supplies, no chained slaves, no grand king on throne. Early practical technologies: wooden wheels, metal fittings, ceramic filters, no railways or electrical poles, no futuristic devices. The marvel is a materially self-sufficient humane settlement rather than beams of magic. Nuanced lived-in textures, beautiful atmospheric architectural illustration, clear connected water levels, no impossible waterfalls, no inscriptions or text. Historical visual reconstruction, not exact archaeological plan.
interpretation: Ricostruzione illustrativa; non aggiunge misure, topologia o funzioni al canone.
visual_review: APPROVATA: soggetto, natura illustrativa e assenza di poteri nuovi verificati
